title: Test comment still describes the removed cover 'explicit place' watermark layer — contradicts the template's own 'Do NOT re-add it' note (r1 W1 fix updated one comment but not its mirror)
detail: The r1 W1 fix removed the cover's explicit watermark place but missed this mirror comment. It now documents a non-existent mechanism and falsely explains the every-page guarantee; a maintainer following it could re-add the double layer W1 removed.
recommended_fix: Update the comment: the watermark is attached solely via `set page(background:)` on both page styles (cover 215, interior 268), so every page carries it by construction.

title: No-op `let _ = application_id` in payload_for error branch (confirmed r1 note, unaddressed by the r1-fix commit)
detail: The parameter is already consumed by the list.find closure above; the discard suppresses nothing. Pure dead line, contrary to the project's no-dead-code rule. r1 flagged it; the fix commit left it.
recommended_fix: Delete the `let _ = application_id` line (r1's recommended fix).

title: typst-test helpers (skip_if_no_typst/typst_available/priv_dir/normalize_metadata) now copied across THREE test files — the r1 fix itself added the third copy instead of extracting to the existing shared module
detail: AGENTS.md DRY rule: extract at 2+ repeats. A skip-policy change (e.g. CI panic wording) now touches three files; the next typst-dependent test copies again. r1 confirmed this at two files; unaddressed and grown.
recommended_fix: Move typst_available/normalize_metadata/priv_dir/skip_if_no_typst into server/test/test_helpers.gleam (panic message as an argument) and import from all three modules.
